tasks.short: Record environmental sample data to monitor IPM effectiveness.

steps.what: Establish actual soil, air, water or pest sample observations and IPM context
inputs: actual sampling protocol, location and IPM treatment history

steps.what: Record actual sample values using native sample, location and treatment identifiers
Calculate chosen IPM monitoring summaries with verified formulas and comparable sample intervals
outputs: checked monitoring summaries and missingness flags

steps.what: Check final environmental records, source values, units and limits on IPM interpretation
inputs: checked monitoring summaries and missingness flags

steps.what: Commit final actual environmental sample and monitoring records

tasks.design: Configure native sample/location fields in agricultural laboratory/field-data software {OTHER}, using checked summaries in {SPREADSHEET} only where needed. Retain actual sample measurements and full source checking before a separate commit; reduce repeated identifiers and fixed arithmetic.
tasks.previous_blocker: Environmental records can repeat identifiers and monitoring calculations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native sample fields and verified formulas reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling comparability and IPM-effectiveness interpretation need actual context.
tasks.human_edge: The technician sees that a changed sampling method makes a comparison misleading.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native sample fields and fixed summaries can reduce repeated recording; actual measurements and IPM interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Technician produces actual observations in s1; no assumed sensor import or free transcription. Actual protocol/master owners provide verified identifiers and approved summaries.

New values, complete checking and interpretation retained. Existing prefill/formulas earn zero saving. Summary branch only if actually required; remove unused branch and reweight. Any actual report delivery or treatment decision has a separate final-version gate with no saving assumed.
unknowns: Which identifiers and summary calculations repeat?
research_questions: Can native fields reduce effort after complete source/interval checks?

incremental.description: Maintain sample/treatment fields and checked summary formulas.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final environmental records and sample destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 25*0.40+15*0.50=17.5 gross minus1 upkeep; low halves gross. Actual measurements and complete checking retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine actual seed germination rates in specified areas.

steps.what: Observe actual planted areas and count seeds/sown units and germinated seedlings under protocol
inputs: actual specified areas and planting records
outputs: actual checked numerator, denominator, area and observation time

steps.what: Calculate germination rates with native checked formulas and denominator safeguards
inputs: actual checked numerator, denominator, area and observation time
outputs: calculated actual germination rates with missing/invalid denominator flags

steps.what: Determine valid germination rates after checking actual area, timing and counting limitations
inputs: calculated actual germination rates with missing/invalid denominator flags

steps.what: Capture and check final actual germination findings and specified area destination
Save final actual germination-rate record

tasks.design: Configure verified germination-rate formulas in {SPREADSHEET} from actual technician counts. Retain actual area observations, denominator/timing checks and full final findings checking before a separate record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same protocol arithmetic can be repeated for each area.
tasks.enabler_now: Native checked formulas can reduce arithmetic repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Correct counting, denominator and observation timing require actual field evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The technician detects a count that does not represent the specified planted area.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checked formulas can compute germination rates from actual counts; field observations remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual planting owner supplies sowing denominator and protocol; technician verifies it and counts actual germination. Missing denominator stays unresolved, not guessed.
Existing formulas earn zero saving. Record only if actually required; remove unused branch and reweight. Any actual results delivery is separately final-version gated with no saving claimed.
unknowns: Which calculation is actually repeated manually?
research_questions: Do formulas reduce arithmetic after full count/denominator checks?

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final germination record and area destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*0.50=10 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Actual counts, interpretation and new record/check retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Respond to actual public inquiries and requests.

steps.what: Hear or read actual public inquiry and clarify the agricultural information requested
outputs: actual understood inquiry and response channel

steps.what: Retrieve and verify approved public agricultural information relevant to actual inquiry
inputs: actual understood inquiry and response channel

steps.what: Choose, compose and check final response, scope, disclosure and exact public recipient
inputs: actual understood inquiry and response channel
outputs: checked final actual public response and exact recipient/channel

steps.what: Deliver final checked response to the actual public requester
inputs: checked final actual public response and exact recipient/channel

tasks.design: Configure native lookup across approved public information in {DOCS} and {CMS}. Retain actual inquiry clarification, all response composition and full final checking before a separate response delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current approved public information can repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed public-source links reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Specific requests may exceed the technician's information or authority.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises a request that requires a scientist's answer.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native approved-source lookup can reduce navigation; actual response judgement remains human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual information owners provide current approved public sources; missing/unsupported answer returns to manual inquiry/escalation. Existing search earns zero saving.

Written route shown. Actual spoken route reweights delivery/conversation without claiming avoided speech. New question returns to lookup/final-response check and separate delivery. No research-sensitive disclosure or invented inquiry log.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final response, actual public recipient and channel; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*0.50=10 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. All response composition, checking and delivery retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual agricultural demonstration requirements, approved methods and source materials
inputs: actual approved method and source materials

steps.what: Choose actual demonstration content, specimens, equipment and explanations
inputs: actual audience needs and available agricultural materials
outputs: chosen actual demonstration content and equipment

steps.what: Assemble demonstration notes using native chosen-method sections
inputs: chosen actual demonstration content and equipment

steps.what: Check complete final demonstration notes and actual method applicability
inputs: actual approved method and chosen equipment

steps.what: Save final actual demonstration notes
Prepare physical agricultural demonstration and present actual methods with audience questions
inputs: actual specimens, equipment, conditions and audience

tasks.design: Configure native method/source links and reusable demonstration sections in {DOCS} and {PROJECT}. Keep content choice and complete note checking before separate save, with actual physical preparation and presentation fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Demonstration preparation can repeat method lookup and note assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native approved-method links and sections reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Actual equipment, specimens and audience understanding require hands-on work.
tasks.human_edge: The technician adapts the actual demonstration when conditions or audience understanding change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native method links and reusable sections can support demonstration preparation; actual physical presentation remains human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual approved-method owners supply sources, technician chooses and checks actual applicability. Existing links/reuse earns zero new saving.

Preparation/presentation alternatives reweight actual ownership. Notes only if actual; any actual attendee handout delivery or publication is a separate exact-final-version action with no saving assumed. Physical setup and audience response fully retained.
unknowns: Which method lookup and note sections repeat?
research_questions: Do native sections reduce preparation after complete method checks?

incremental.description: Maintain approved demonstration links and sections.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final demonstration notes and storage destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*0.40+20*0.40=14 gross minus1 upkeep; low halves gross. Content choice, full checking and all physical work retained.
